017package org.apache.juneau.http;
018
019/**
020 * Neutralizes log-forging (log-injection) in client-controlled strings before they are written to a log line.
021 *
022 * <p>
023 * A remote client can place CR/LF (or Unicode line/paragraph separators, bidi controls, or other control characters)
024 * into a request URI, header name/value, or body, and — if that text is interpolated verbatim into a log record — forge
025 * additional physical log lines (e.g. a fake status banner) or corrupt a downstream log parser/SIEM. This utility
026 * replaces every such character with a <b>visible, inert escape</b> (<c>\r</c>, <c>\n</c>, or <c>\\uXXXX</c>) so the
027 * value's information is preserved (a reader can still see there <i>was</i> a newline) but it can no longer terminate
028 * the current line or start a new one.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * The transform:
032 * <ul>
033 *    <li>CR (<c>\\u000D</c>) &rarr; <c>\r</c>, LF (<c>\\u000A</c>) &rarr; <c>\n</c>.
034 *    <li>All other C0 controls (<c>\\u0000</c>&ndash;<c>\\u001F</c>) <b>except TAB</b> (<c>\\u0009</c>) &rarr; <c>\\uXXXX</c>.
035 *    <li>DEL and C1 controls (<c>\\u007F</c>&ndash;<c>\\u009F</c>, which includes NEL <c>\\u0085</c>) &rarr; <c>\\uXXXX</c>.
036 *    <li>Line separator (<c>\\u2028</c>), paragraph separator (<c>\\u2029</c>), and bidi controls
037 *       (<c>\\u202A</c>&ndash;<c>\\u202E</c>, <c>\\u2066</c>&ndash;<c>\\u2069</c>) &rarr; <c>\\uXXXX</c>.
038 *    <li>TAB (<c>\\u0009</c>) is <b>preserved</b> &mdash; it cannot forge a line.
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * When a length cap is supplied, truncation is applied <b>after</b> escaping, counts <b>sanitized</b> (character) output,
043 * appends a <c>&hellip;[truncated]</c> marker, and never cuts an escape sequence or a surrogate pair in half. A fast path
044 * returns the original reference unchanged when the string contains no character requiring an escape and is within the
045 * cap, so well-behaved clients incur no allocation.
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * All methods are thread-safe (the utility is stateless).
049 *
050 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
051 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestServerLoggingAndDebugging">Logging / Debugging</a>
052 * </ul>
053 *
054 * @since 10.0.0
055 */
056public final class DebugTextSanitizer {
057
058   /** Marker appended when a value is truncated by the length cap. */
059   public static final String TRUNCATED_MARKER = "\u2026[truncated]";
060
061   private DebugTextSanitizer() {}
062
063   /**
064    * Escapes every log-forging control character in the given string, with no length cap.
065    *
066    * @param value The string to sanitize. Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
067    * @return The sanitized string, or the original reference if nothing needed escaping. <jk>null</jk> if the input was
068    *    <jk>null</jk>.
069    */
070   public static String sanitize(String value) {
071      return sanitize(value, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Escapes every log-forging control character in the given string, then caps the <i>sanitized</i> output to
076    * {@code maxLen} characters.
077    *
078    * <p>
079    * The cap counts the escaped (rendered) length, appends {@code …[truncated]} when it clips, and never splits an
080    * escape sequence or a surrogate pair.
081    *
082    * @param value The string to sanitize. Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
083    * @param maxLen The maximum number of sanitized characters to keep (excluding the truncation marker).
084    * @return The sanitized (and possibly truncated) string, or the original reference if nothing needed escaping and it
085    *    was within the cap. <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
086    */
087   @SuppressWarnings({
088      "java:S3776" // Sanitizer encodes a control-character state machine; complexity is inherent.
089   })
090   public static String sanitize(String value, int maxLen) {
091      if (value == null)
092         return null;
093
094      // Fast path: nothing to escape and already within the cap → return the original reference (no allocation).
095      var clean = value.length() <= maxLen;
096      if (clean) {
097         for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
098            if (needsEscape(value.charAt(i))) {
099               clean = false;
100               break;
101            }
102         }
103      }
104      if (clean)
105         return value;
106
107      var sb = new StringBuilder(Math.min(value.length(), Math.max(maxLen, 0)) + 16);
108      var truncated = false;
109      var n = value.length();
110      var i = 0;
111      while (i < n) {
112         var c = value.charAt(i);
113         String token;
114         int consumed;
115         if (needsEscape(c)) {
116            token = escape(c);
117            consumed = 1;
118         } else if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c) && i + 1 < n && Character.isLowSurrogate(value.charAt(i + 1))) {
119            // Keep a surrogate pair together so the cap never cuts a code point in half.
120            token = value.substring(i, i + 2);
121            consumed = 2;
122         } else {
123            token = String.valueOf(c);
124            consumed = 1;
125         }
126         if (sb.length() + token.length() > maxLen) {
127            truncated = true;
128            break;
129         }
130         sb.append(token);
131         i += consumed;
132      }
133      if (truncated)
134         sb.append(TRUNCATED_MARKER);
135      return sb.toString();
136   }
137
138   private static boolean needsEscape(char c) {
139      if (c == '\t')
140         return false;
141      if (c <= '\u001F')  // C0 controls (CR/LF included).
142         return true;
143      if (c >= '\u007F' && c <= '\u009F')  // DEL + C1 controls (includes NEL \u0085).
144         return true;
145      if (c == '\u2028' || c == '\u2029')  // Line / paragraph separators.
146         return true;
147      if (c >= '\u202A' && c <= '\u202E')  // Bidi embedding/override controls.
148         return true;
149      return c >= '\u2066' && c <= '\u2069';  // Bidi isolate controls.
150   }
151
152   private static String escape(char c) {
153      if (c == '\r')
154         return "\\r";
155      if (c == '\n')
156         return "\\n";
157      return String.format("\\u%04X", (int) c);
158   }
159}
